visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler girl with pigtails and a white polka-dot dress is seen sitting on a grey play mat in a sunlit living room. She is intensely focused on a red pirate barrel toy, using her small hands to push a purple-headed figure down into the center while her mother's hand points toward the mechanism. (2) Suddenly, the toy figure pops upward, and the girl captures it with a curious and delighted expression. She holds the figure up toward the camera, showing it off while a large beige sofa and bright windows are visible in the background. (3) The girl transitions to cleaning up, picking up colorful toy swords from the mat and carefully placing them into a transparent plastic bag. The scene is brightly lit by natural light coming through a large window overlooking green foliage outside. (4) The scene shifts to a game of hide-and-seek. The girl is seen crawling underneath large white bean bag chairs on the floor, while a pair of yellow slippers and a low table sit nearby. The camera pans across the room, showing a shelf filled with various plush toys and books. (5) Emerging from her hiding spot, the girl sits on the sofa with an adult woman, whose hand is seen pointing at a colorful picture book featuring an elephant. The girl mirrors the elephant's trunk by putting her hand to her nose, demonstrating her learning and imitation skills. (6) In the final sequence, the girl walks towards an orange and white tabby cat that is strolling across the wooden floor. She attempts to place a red reindeer antler headband on the cat's head, showing a gentle but persistent interaction with the pet before the video ends with a pink brand screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a light-hearted, medium-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a soft piano line. An adult female voice, characterized by high pitch and a nurturing tone, explains a toy's mechanism to a child. Subtle plastic clicking sounds occur as the child interacts with the objects on a padded mat. (2) A sharp, resonant 'pop' sound signifies the toy pirate jumping out, followed immediately by the adult's high-arousal cheer of 'Na chu lai le!' (It's out!). The toddler responds with a soft, breathy vocalization. The sound of crinkling plastic follows as toys are gathered into a bag. (3) The audio environment shifts as the adult counts loudly from one to ten in Mandarin, with a slight room reverb suggesting a larger space. Soft thumping sounds of the child's feet and the rustle of fabric from bean bags are audible during the hide-and-seek segment, accompanied by the adult's searching questions. (4) During the reading portion, the acoustic music continues as a steady background bed. The dialogue becomes more rhythmic as the child repeats 'Du du' and 'Chang' (long) after the adult. The speech rate is slow and enunciated, typical of pedagogical interaction with a toddler. (5) The final phase features the child's determined voice as she interacts with a cat, followed by the adult's soft laughter and a concluding announcement that 'Grandma is back.' The audio quality is clean, with minimal background noise and a balanced music-to-speech ratio.
